-- AL-3: Mike Rogers won R primary (83.2%), not Terri LaPoint
UPDATE house_races SET candidate2_name = 'Mike Rogers', candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'AL' AND district = '3';

-- AL-5: Dale Strong (R, unopposed); D primary going to runoff (Sneed vs Duvieilh, June 16)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'A. Sneed → C. Duvieilh (D Runoff, June 16)',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'AL' AND district = '5';

SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'AL' ORDER BY district;
